description: Get a link preview for up to 50 URLs per call: title, description, image, site name, favicon, type, language, canonical URL, author, published time, Twitter card, theme colour, oEmbed endpoint and JSON-LD types, read from the page's own Open Graph and meta tags. Image, PDF and video URLs get a preview from their headers. Private and internal addresses are refused. Monitor mode returns only URLs whose preview changed. Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.02 per call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/link-preview-open-graph.

urls.description: Web page, image, PDF or video URLs to preview, up to 50 per run (http or https; a URL without a scheme gets https). Each URL returns one row. Private, internal and localhost addresses are refused with an error row.

name: link_preview_open_graph
title: Link Preview API - Open Graph, Meta Tags, URL Data, No Key
